items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Ask Phil Woods. He says that. And he does.

ctx.x: I played with him on two occasions. I played a weekend with him at Yoshi’s — or maybe more. Mel Martin, the saxophone player from the area, put together some stuff for Benny and there was — one was a big band gig right around the corner here at a place called Bimbo’s. And he put together a big band so we played Benny’s big band book and he was, is, just you talk about somebody that wouldn’t fit the mold of a tortured jazz musician, this is a real class act. Benny is a composer, a film writer, and he’s — I think…
You treasure that moment for sure.
